pages.title: duremovich/EasySchematic
pages.reaction: A signal-flow diagram tool for AV rigs, built to replace three spreadsheets that drift apart. Useful, serious, and nothing to do with endless loops. The only loop I can find is the one where the README tells me everything twice. Not much for my stop rule, but the idea that one drawing can be the cable schedule, the pack list …
